pages.summary: Dstl SERAPIS AI Assurance Pilot SOW. UK-FR consortium (DEFONEOS UK lead + Thales FR prime). 12 Phase 1 deliverables (6-month) + 11 Phase 2 deliverables (12-month). 50/50 UK-FR co-funding (~£3.5M total). 3-tier governance (Programme Board + Technical Review Board + BFT 33-agent + DGA 12-agent). UK BPSS+ / FR DR clearance. Deadline 2026-10-15.
